mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10Y-2Y < 0) within the next 6 months, indicating a looming recession that will negate the positive earnings signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation remains below 2% over the next 6 months, indicating that wage pressures are not spilling over into broad inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation remains below 2% over the next 6 months, indicating that the supply shock is not driving broad inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 4% signals a hawkish Fed that will tighten financial conditions and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where the federal funds rate exceeds 4%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the housing starts index, signals a weakening economy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve steepens (10Y-2Y > 2%) within the next 6 months, indicating a return to growth.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating growth in nonfarm payrolls, as measured by the year-over-year change in the PAYEMS series, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Core PCE inflation remains below 2% over the next 6 months, indicating that labor market strength is not driving broad inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index above 3% signals rising inflation expectations that will drive a hawkish Fed response and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPI exceeds 3%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the federal funds rate below 1% signals a dovish Fed that will ease financial conditions and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain negative in > 40% of instances where the federal funds rate is below 1%.
